name: io.github.Saneth98/smart-ocr-pdf-invoice-receipt-json
title: Smart OCR — PDF, Invoice & Receipt to JSON/Table API
description: Extract custom JSON schemas and Excel/CSV tables from PDFs, invoices, statements, and receipts.

tools.name: extract_document_table
tools.description: Extract structured table rows (line items, transactions, headers, document metadata, summary totals, Markdown table, and CSV) from a PDF or image (invoice, bank statement, credit card statement, receipt, timesheet, or scanned table). Works immediately on the free tier (2 free documents/day) or with an optional Smart OCR API key.

file_url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL to a PDF, PNG, JPG, WEBP, or TIFF document to extract.

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded document content (raw base64 or data:...;base64,... URI). Provide either file_url or file_base64.

file_name.description: Optional filename with extension (e.g., "invoice.pdf", "statement.pdf", "receipt.png"). Defaults to "document.pdf".

preset.description: Document preset: "invoice" for vendor invoices/bills, "bank_statement" for bank or credit card statements, "receipt" for retail/expense receipts, or "auto" to auto-detect.

custom_headers.description: Optional list of custom column headers to extract (e.g., ["Date", "Description", "Amount", "Balance"]).

api_key.description: Optional Smart OCR API key from https://smartocr.dev (can also be sent via x-api-key header). If omitted, uses the free tier (2 free docs/day).

tools.name: extract_document_json
tools.description: Extract strict, structured JSON matching any custom JSON schema or field template from a PDF or image (PNG, JPG, WEBP, TIFF). Ideal for developer pipelines, ERP/accounting ingestion, and custom document fields. Works on the free tier (2 free docs/day) or with a Smart OCR API key (10 free credits at https://smartocr.dev).

file_url.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL to a PDF, PNG, JPG, WEBP, or TIFF document to extract.

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded document content (raw base64 or data:...;base64,... URI). Provide either file_url or file_base64.

schema.description: Target JSON schema or key-value object template describing the fields to extract (e.g., {"vendorName": "string", "invoiceNumber": "string", "invoiceDate": "string", "totalAmount": "number", "lineItems": [{"description": "string", "quantity": "number", "amount": "number"}]}).

api_key.description: Optional Smart OCR API key from https://smartocr.dev (can also be sent via x-api-key header). If omitted, uses the free tier (2 free docs/day).

tools.name: get_smartocr_status
tools.description: Check Smart OCR service status, remaining free daily document quota (2 free documents/day), or developer API key credit balance, plus links to the web converter (https://read.smartocr.dev) and API portal (https://smartocr.dev).

api_key.description: Optional Smart OCR API key to check your remaining API credit balance.
